abstract: The computed tomographic (CT) findings in nine benign cystic teratomas are presented and compared with radiographic, sonographic, and pathologic data. CT rendered a specific diagnosis in six cases and was highly suggestive in two, with results superior to other imaging methods. In each instance, CT was successful in predicting or excluding invasion of adjacent structures, but was not reliable in predicting or excluding adherence to them. Specific CT characteristics of benign cystic teratomas are predominantly fatty mass with a denser dependent element and globular calcification, bone, or teeth in a solid protuberance into the cyst cavity. Suggestive patterns include fatty mass with rim calcification and water density mass with globular calcification and solid tissue elements. Illustrated for the first time are the CT appearances of the different calcifications seen in benign cystic teratomas.
abstract_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫9例のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を提示し、単純X線、超音波、病理所見と比較した。CTは6例で特異的診断が可能であり、2例では強く示唆された。いずれの症例でも、CTは隣接構造への浸潤の予測または除外に成功したが、隣接構造への癒着の予測または除外には信頼性がなかった。良性嚢胞性奇形腫の特徴的なCT所見は、主に脂肪性腫瘤で、密度の高い下垂部分があり、球状石灰化、骨、または歯が嚢胞腔内へ突出する充実性隆起部に見られることである。示唆的な所見として、辺縁石灰化を伴う脂肪性腫瘤や、球状石灰化と充実性成分を伴う水濃度の腫瘤が挙げられる。良性嚢胞性奇形腫に見られるさまざまな石灰化のCT像を初めて図示した。
